accepted_design: Explicit new human interruption permission allows normal FIFO without foreign-router-demand yield. Same selected model/settings and two literal fixtures retained. No shared cancellation, restart, candidate or prior-P0 regrade.

Own SSE rate is correctly labelled rounded native server rate; API generated count is kept separate. Actual selected request_timings uses native last.generated fallback and rounds predicted_per_second to0.1. No exact native count is invented.

New sample/panel deadline, natural completion, typed counters, manual-quality pending, own-socket cancellation and remaining UNRUN behavior are covered by eight actual supplied controls; no tests executed by reviewer.

blocking_findings.problem: claim occurs before the protected try; inherited claim may write own state then fail readback. This path bypasses cleanup. release failure in finally also masks primary failure and skips guard_binding.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Protect claim; retain primary/release/post-owner errors separately, clean only matching own reservation, always attempt metadata-only guard independently of release success, persist terminal cleanup receipt when exact owned output exists.
required_controls: Actual mocked main where claim writes matching own reservation then raises: own cleanup attempted and original failure retained.
